descriptions.normal: Radish-based vegetable soup. Its flavor is delicately between tart and sweet. With luscious radish, it's a well-balanced dish.
descriptions.suspicious: Radish-based vegetable soup. The vegetables within appear to have been victims of a frost.
descriptions.delicious: Radish-based vegetable soup. The clear aromas are perfectly accompanied by a sunny summer afternoon.

effectTexts.normal: Restores 9% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 260 HP every 5s for 30s.
effectTexts.suspicious: Restores 8% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 210 HP every 5s for 30s.
effectTexts.delicious: Restores 10% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 300 HP every 5s for 30s.
